name: Freshdesk
description: A cloud-based customer service software that provides help desk support with multi-channel ticketing and customer engagement tools.

evidence.claim: Freshdesk has an official MCP server integration for AI tools like Cursor and Claude.
Freshdesk offers a free plan (Free/Sprout) and self-serve signup.
The API supports broad operations across tickets, contacts, companies, and knowledge base.
Freshdesk API v2 uses API keys for authentication, typically passed via Basic Auth.

notes: Freshdesk provides a robust REST API (v2) and has recently embraced the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with an official integration to support AI agents and tools.
